newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras maintained as buy.

text.p: Caspian Secrities said it maintained its buy recommendation on shares of Brazilian telecoms holding Telebras due to the firm's long-term outlook.
-- "We continue to recommend purchase of Telebras as long-term fundamentals remain strong," said Caspian analysts Joanne Showalter and Tony Figueiredo said in a report.
-- But it said company's second-quarter earnings of $2.33 per ADS was below its estimate of $2.75 per ADS and consensus forecast of $2.55.
-- Friday, Telebras released a net profit of 1.494 billion reais for the first half of 1997, including a June net profit of 315 million reais.
-- The analysts also said Telebras' first-half gross cash flow of $5.24 per ADS in the period was below their estimate of $5.60.
-- "Disappointing revenues and were the main culparit for the shortfall in earnings, primarily driven by lower-than-expected local revenues," they wrote.
-- They also said they were disappointed by the "modest" rise in domestic and international long-distance traffic and cash expenses were slightly higher than expected.
-- "At this juncture, we suspect our forecasts for Telebras are too optimistic," they added.

-- Telebras' ADR was down 2n03 at 138 in New York while its preferred share was off 1.18 percent at 150.20 reais and its common was off 2.87 percent at 135.50 reais in Sao Paulo at 1245 local/1145 edt/1545 gmt.
